capabilities: Index note names and aliases for autocomplete
Index titles, heading times, and property values
Index unlinked mentions, tags, and external links
Expose an API for other plugins
disambiguation: Not a query language like Dataview; it accelerates core calls and exposes an API for other plugins.
extras: Beta versions are installed via the BRAT plugin. Documentation is an interactive demo vault with per-feature notes and measurement buttons; a copy ships with each release. Debug messages are hidden by default. Derived caches stay on each device; heading history and registered property names sync through ordinary vault files.
intentEvidence: replacing the method that already asks the question, so nothing has to know the plugin is installed
problem: Obsidian answers backlinks, link suggestions, and name lookups by scanning every note on each call, which is slow on large vaults.

relations.evidence: Supersedes Backlink Cache: includes its backlink index; adds: names, titles, headings, properties, unlinked mentions
Alternative wikilink suggester; link-count and manual-boost ordering
Different integration: accelerates core calls and their consumers; no query language
Different integration: core calls and startup-loaded property lookups; no query language
Complementary title lookup: finds notes by title; offers titles in autocomplete; no display changes
Alternative index access: in-memory core calls and plugin API; no export file
The handle comes from the @mnaoumov/obsidian-lib plugin registry

summary: Plugin that maintains vault indexes and answers Obsidian's built-in lookups from them, so backlinks and link suggestions avoid rescanning every note.
